description: Named settlements with population: cities, towns and villages, used to name a point and rank places.

world.name: GeoNames
world.notes: Places with population 1000+. Each city carries an IANA time zone, used for time zones until a boundary pack exists. alternateNamesV2 (all alternate names, streamed from the zip) gives the world pack's alias columns on cities, admin1 and countries: English names, abbreviations, IATA codes attached to cities and short names; historic names only where a curated dataset confirms them (packbuild.world_aliases).

world.name: GHSL Settlement Model grid (GHS-SMOD R2023A), European Commission Joint Research Centre
world.credit: © European Union, 1995-2026, GHSL (JRC), CC BY 4.0; Schiavina M., Melchiorri M., Pesaresi M. (2023): GHS-SMOD R2023A, doi:10.2905/A0DF7A6F-49DE-46EA-9BDE-563437A6E2BA
world.notes: The 2020 epoch of the Degree of Urbanisation grid (1 km, World Mollweide ESRI:54009), 36 MB zip. The folder's copyright.txt: '(c) European Union, 1995-2026 ... Any copyright and/or sui generis right on the dataset is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence. Reuse is allowed provided appropriate credit is given and any changes are indicated.' Changes: urban centres (class 30) and dense and semi-dense urban clusters (23, 22) traced into outlines, cut at Natural Earth's borders, simplified, unprojected and named from GeoNames; populations from the zip's own urban centre and dense urban cluster extracts (packbuild.towns). The grid is read without GDAL (packbuild/sources/ghsl/geotiff.py: BigTIFF, LZW tiles). Releases are immutable, release-coded folders on the JRC FTP; new ones come every 2-3 years.

world.name: placewise curated datasets: names and airports (datasets/names, datasets/airports)
world.notes: Curated by the placewise project and licensed CC BY 4.0 (datasets/LICENSE.md in the placewise-data repository): the names people type for places (airport codes, short forms, nicknames, former names, with the GeoNames alternate names to drop), each code citing its OurAirports page and each former name a page on the rename; India's former state and city names (datasets/names/ind.json); and the city each major airport serves (datasets/airports/served.json).

usa.name: US Census Bureau cartographic boundaries, gazetteer, population estimates and metro delineations
usa.notes: Works of the US federal government are not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. 105). Boundaries are the 2025 cartographic boundary files at 1:500,000 (generalised from TIGER/Line and clipped to the shoreline, so points in bays and coastal water fall in no county or place); ZIP Code Tabulation Areas exist only in the 2020 vintage, since ZCTAs are defined once per decennial census. ZCTAs approximate USPS ZIP Code delivery areas, which USPS does not publish as areas. Place populations are the Vintage 2025 Population Estimates (SUB-EST2025, July 2025) for incorporated places (and Urban Honolulu CDP, Hawaii having no incorporated places), and the American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates (table B01003, total population, from the table-based summary file, which needs no API key) for census-designated places and any place SUB-EST lacks; ZCTA populations are ACS too. CBSA and CSA membership is the July 2023 delineation (OMB Bulletin 23-01): list 1 for counties, list 2 for principal cities. Each ZCTA's postal city name is the city ZIP Code Business Patterns 2023 (County Business Patterns program) gives its ZIP Code, matched to a census place by name within the state, preferring places the 2020 ZCTA-to-place relationship file says overlap the ZCTA; ZIP Codes Business Patterns lacks are named from the other US postal source in postal.json. The files are NAD83 (EPSG:4269), used as WGS84: the two differ by 1-2 m in the US, within the generalisation of these files.

can.name: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census of Population, population and dwelling counts
can.credit: Adapted from Statistics Canada, Census of Population 2021, Population and dwelling counts (tables 98-10-0002-01, 98-10-0005-01 and 98-10-0019-01), reference date May 11, 2021. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
can.notes: Full-table CSV downloads. 98-10-0002-01 covers Canada, provinces and territories, census divisions and census subdivisions; 98-10-0005-01 CMAs and CAs (whole and by provincial part); 98-10-0019-01 forward sortation areas. Joined to the boundaries on DGUID. 63 CSDs (incompletely enumerated Indian reserves and settlements) have no count (symbol '..'); they are stored as null, not zero.

can.name: Canadian Geographical Names Database (CGNDB), Natural Resources Canada
can.credit: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada (Canadian Geographical Names Database, Natural Resources Canada).
can.notes: Official geographical names approved by the Geographical Names Board of Canada and its provincial and territorial members, refreshed weekly (the national English-format CSV; names keep the language they were decided in, English or French, and are not translated). The Canada pack keeps generic category 'Populated Place' (hamlets, communities, towns, urban communities, neighbourhoods, Montreal's boroughs: about 26,000 points) without railway points, post offices, stations and former or vacated places, with the 'Relevance at Scale' field as a prominence. Coordinates are NAD83, used as WGS84. Points only, no boundaries or populations.

ind.name: All India Pincode Directory (Department of Posts, Open Government Data Platform India)
ind.credit: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India. All India Pincode Directory, sourced from the Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India (data.gov.in), under the Government Open Data Licence - India (GODL), https://www.data.gov.in/Godl
ind.notes: Neighbourhood points: post offices inside cities, named without their type words ('Koramangala S.O' -> Koramangala); institutional offices (colleges, courts, hospitals) are left out by the curated not_neighbourhoods words.
